open_points.subject: create_expense_from_recognition audit timestamp
open_points.text: - create_expense_from_recognition: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it writes and every current-time comparison it makes; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself.
open_points.other_text: def append_audit(repository: AuditRepository, intent: AuditIntent) -> AuditRecord
open_points.question: Must append_audit change to accept the operation instant, or is the audit record's occurred_at exempt from “every timestamp it writes”?
